verified session OR signed guest cookie
All /v1 access is scoped by the trusted userId the UserContextGuard
establishes (ADR-0007/0012) — a verified better-auth session or an
HMAC-signed guest cookie, never a client-supplied identity.
better-auth (ADR-0009) mounts *behind* that seam, not around it.
@steuereule/core is the single home of deterministic rules
(validators, cockpitRange), imported by both api and frontend.
